description: Retrieves a list of documents. Use 'parameters' for filtering (e.g., {'query': 'search term'}).
Retrieves details of a specific document by ID. The ID must be in the endpoint path.
Uploads a new document. (Note: File data must be handled by a separate n8n step; you can only create the document metadata entry).
Updates an existing document by ID. Use 'body' for the new data.
Retrieves a list of labels (also known as tags in Paperless-ngx).
Retrieves details of a specific label by ID.
Creates a new label. Use 'body' for {'name': 'new_label_name'}.
Updates an existing label by ID. Use 'body' for the new data.
